name: AttuneNext

approval.source: Memory attunenext-workflow (2026-11-14, newest, stricter, wins): the user asks for each outward step explicitly and separately (commit, push, build the zip, create the GitHub release, copy into AddOns); "Do not push or publish without being told." Older memory release-and-wiki-every-commit (2026-10-26): every commit to main gets a version bump, a published release and a wiki update when relevant; user's words: "always update the wiki in the future when there are relevant changes... create and publish a new release... always do so with each commit".

delivery.commitStyle: The change in its own commit(s), then a separate version commit "vX.Y.Z: <summary>" holding the Core.lua / .toc bump and the new CHANGELOG.md entry, e.g. "v4.1.2: audit fixes (B1-B10, P1-P3)".

release.title: v{version}
release.notesStyle: **v{version}** on the first line, then the body of the top CHANGELOG.md entry (the '## vX.Y.Z' heading itself left out).

wiki.rules: Push wiki edits right after the release, so the wiki never describes unreleased behaviour. Developer-Notes has a 'Releasing' section that documents these steps: update it if the routine changes.

notes: Ask before each step: commit, push, tag + zip + release, wiki. Finish the change, run the headless harness (docs/perf-audit/tools/harness_scenarios.py, from a scratch copy of the tools because scenario runs drop files into tools/), report, then offer the commit. The live checkout IS the installed addon (the game's AddOns folder, branch main): commits are live on the next /reload, so there is no copy-into-AddOns step. git fetch first: main has moved under a clone before. Write the new top CHANGELOG.md entry ('## vX.Y.Z') by hand in the version commit; it is not a version field (every past heading would match). The zip is git archive --format=zip --prefix=AttuneNext/ of the tag (docs/ and .claude/ are export-ignore); the local folder for release zips is in ship.local.json. The repo stores LF and checks out CRLF (autocrlf): exact-match edit scripts must normalise line endings. Keep '.claude/ export-ignore' in .gitattributes, or ship.json ends up in the players' zip. This file is public: no names or local paths here (those go in ship.local.json). Engine.lua changes are ported to AttuneNext-Simple (its local clone is in ship.local.json) by regenerating its Engine.lua; Simple has no ship rule, and installing it into AddOns is a separate step the user approves. Never stage the untracked update.bat.
